lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs are visible. Central columns contain 4 to 5 distinct nodes, with the vertical spacing between centroids remaining relatively constant across the mid-section before tapering posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a discernible rectilinear grid of anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible, defined by sharp vertical intensity gradients featuring highlights on the dorsal-facing edge and shadows on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of small, low-contrast high-luminance blobs is visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated in the lower two-thirds of the fin surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct white trailing object or tag is attached to the posterior distal tip of the pectoral fin. An irregular indentation or notch is visible on the trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin surface exhibits a high-density, disordered cluster of smaller high-luminance spots that contrast with the ordered grid pattern of the lateral flank.
